name: The keep
description: A ruined keep above Traublassen built by Taivas with an ossuary of memories beneath it where Umbris is bound.

timeline.summary: Boris guides Torens to the keep, unlocks the iron door with a brass sphere, and locks them inside along with Aleksandar who followed to repay Torens.
timeline.quote: He shut and locked the door behind them.

relations.note: He built the keep's door and bound Umbris there.
relations.quote: "My great-great-grandfather Taivas built this door," Boris said
